test_case.test_name: All-DIMM 1DPC memory stress for 12 hours at 0C/-5% rails
test_case.purpose: Verify every approved 1DPC DIMM/channel remains stable under full memory stress at cold/low-rail margin without training, ECC/RAS, OOM, hang or platform error.
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff install the approved 1DPC map under ESD controls, establish dry 0C/-5% conditions, run the NUMA-aware all-memory SST profile for 12 hours with controller telemetry, then warm dry and restore the reference population/environment.
test_case.expected_result: All mapped DIMMs train to expected capacity and complete full coverage with no disallowed ECC/MCE/RAS, OOM, thermal, heartbeat or platform event.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires topology-linked coverage for every DIMM/channel and full duration; aggregate allocation, another population or unapproved corrected-error limit cannot pass.
safety_gate: Reserve OS/control memory and maintain OOB
Abort on training/ECC/RAS/OOM, moisture, electrical or thermal fault
Preserve logs; no auto-retry; dry warm-up
test_case.recovery: Stop on a limit, preserve controller evidence, restore nominal rails, warm/dry before hardware work, restore reference DIMMs/configuration and do not auto-retry.
